library ieee; use ieee.std_logic_1164.all; entity counter is port ( clk : in std_logic; rst : in std_logic; q : out std_logic_vector(7 downto 0) ); end entity; architecture rtl of counter is signal count : integer := 0; begin process (clk, rst) begin if rst = '1' then count <= 0; elsif rising_edge(clk) then count <= count + 1; end if; end process; end architecture;
